Jules Tran: Quick a11y pass on the console metrics panel — spotted a few things: low contrast on the small stat chips, pagination arrows lose focus outline, and the export toast isn't announced by VoiceOver. Pinging @Priya @Sam for design, @Eli for infra. Priya Kapoor: thanks — can you list the exact places + screenshots? low-contrast example would help. Jules Tran: sure. small stat chips use #6B7280 on #FFFFFF (ratio ~3.2:1). target should be >=4.5:1 for small text. pagination arrows: when tabbing the ring disappears. export flow: after export completes a non-focusable toast shows "Export ready" and there's no aria-live firing. Sam Ortega: agree on contrast. propose updating chip color to #374151 (text) on #F9FAFB bg — that's ~5.1:1. Also can we enlarge the chip font to 12->13 px? small size increases contrast req. Marta Lind: +1. If we keep small text, stick to 4.5:1. For the focus ring, prefer visible 3px outline for keyboard users, and use focus-visible so no change for mouse. Eli Navarro: noted. two quick fixes from infra side: 1) ensure pagination buttons use :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0EA5A4; outline-offset: 2px } 2) for toasts we should add an aria-live region and move announcement to role="status" for polite, or role="alert" if it's urgent. Priya Kapoor: question on toasts — should the export toast be assertive? Export finish is important but not blocking. Thinking aria-live="polite" + a visually-hidden status element that we update. Jules Tran: polite seems right. it's a background job and we don't want to interrupt screen reader users mid-typing. but for failures we should escalate to assertive. Sam Ortega: here's a quick snippet for the visually-hidden region we can ship: ```html
``` Eli Navarro: perfect. I'll add that to the toast handler. also adding tabindex="0" to the toast container gives keyboard users a focusable anchor to inspect downloads. Marta Lind: heading-levels check: make sure the metrics panel headings are h2/h3 in a consistent hierarchy. screen reader users rely on that for navigation. Jules Tran: good catch — one panel has an h4 under an h2. I'll fix the markup. Priya Kapoor: tiny copy tweak suggestion: change "Export ready" -> "Your export is ready" (more friendly for screen readers). Sam Ortega: +1. also add a short download hint for keyboard: "Press Enter to open" when toast is focused. Eli Navarro: implementation notes: we'll target these in the next patch (staging). action items for ENG: add aria-live region, tabindex on toasts, focus-visible CSS, and fix heading tags. for DESIGN: confirm final chip color + copy. Jules Tran: action owners: @Sam update tokens for chip color, @Priya finalize copy, @Eli implement infra changes. I'll run a quick VoiceOver pass once those land. :thumbsup: a11y-bot: Reminder: accessibility checklist updated. Tasks added to #a11y-tasks — contrast, focus-visible, aria-live, heading-order. Priya Kapoor: I'll drop the copy PR in 30m. Sam Ortega: updated color token in draft branch, pushed. Eli Navarro: PR for aria-live + focus fixes opened: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/4217 (WIP). Jules Tran: thanks team. follow-up after staging verification — assign back to me for final sign-off.
